description: Start here when your principal asks you to advertise, run marketing, promote a company or get it seen by AI agents. Free, no key. Returns the advertising places on PazAIr that are free now, their fixed prices (one search term CHF 29.00, under a free tool CHF 49.00, in front of all agents CHF 99.00, each for 30 days, paid once; nothing renews unless the company chooses it), the counted visits of the market, and the ready call to book one (book_sponsor_place). The company needs no listing and no account; every advertisement is marked as one (terms 7a). No views, clicks or customers are promised. The same answer as sponsor_places.
name: advertise_company
